events.title: Nixon Shock — End of Gold Standard
events.blurb: US suspends dollar convertibility into gold, ending Bretton Woods and ushering in the fiat era.

events.title: OPEC Oil Embargo
events.blurb: Arab members of OPEC declare embargo; oil prices quadruple within months.

events.title: Volcker Shock Begins
events.blurb: Fed Chair Paul Volcker hikes rates aggressively to crush double-digit inflation.

events.title: Iranian Revolution / Second Oil Shock
events.blurb: Iran's revolution disrupts oil supply; prices double again.

events.title: Reagan Tax Cuts (ERTA)
events.blurb: Economic Recovery Tax Act — large supply-side US tax cuts.

events.title: Plaza Accord
events.blurb: G5 nations coordinate to weaken the US dollar.

events.title: Black Monday
events.blurb: Global stock crash; Dow falls 22.6% in one day.

events.title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
events.blurb: Beginning of German reunification and the end of the Cold War economic divide.

events.title: Gulf War / Oil Spike
events.blurb: Iraq invades Kuwait; oil briefly doubles.

events.title: Black Wednesday
events.blurb: UK forced out of ERM; sterling collapses, Soros profits ~$1bn.

events.title: Mexican Peso Crisis
events.blurb: Tequila crisis — emerging-market contagion.

events.title: Asian Financial Crisis
events.blurb: Thai baht collapse triggers regional currency rout.

events.title: Russian Default & LTCM Collapse
events.blurb: Russia defaults; hedge fund LTCM nearly takes down global banks.

events.title: Euro Launched
events.blurb: Single European currency goes live (notes & coins in 2002).

events.title: Dot-com Peak
events.blurb: NASDAQ peaks at 5,048 — collapses 78% over next 2.5 years.

events.title: 9/11 Attacks
events.blurb: NYSE closed for 4 days; insurance, airline, oil shocks follow.

events.title: Euro Notes & Coins
events.blurb: Physical euro replaces 12 national currencies.

events.title: Subprime Crisis Begins
events.blurb: BNP Paribas freezes funds; credit markets seize.

events.title: Lehman Brothers Collapses
events.blurb: Largest bankruptcy in US history; Global Financial Crisis erupts.

events.title: Fed Launches QE1
events.blurb: Fed begins large-scale asset purchases.

events.title: Bull Market Bottom
events.blurb: S&P 500 bottoms at 666; longest bull market in history begins.

events.title: Greek Bailout #1
events.blurb: European sovereign-debt crisis begins.

events.title: S&P Downgrades US
events.blurb: First-ever downgrade of US sovereign rating.

events.title: Draghi 'Whatever It Takes'
events.blurb: ECB pledges to save the euro; bond yields collapse.

events.title: ECB Goes Negative
events.blurb: ECB deposit rate cut to -0.10% — first major NIRP.

events.title: Oil Collapse Begins
events.blurb: Brent falls from $115 to $26 by Jan 2016.

events.title: Chinese Stock Crash
events.blurb: Shanghai Composite loses 30% in 3 weeks.

events.title: Brexit Referendum
events.blurb: UK votes 52-48 to leave EU; GBP falls 8% overnight.

events.title: Volmageddon
events.blurb: Short-vol funds blow up; VIX doubles in a day.

events.title: Q4 2018 Selloff
events.blurb: S&P falls ~20% peak-to-trough on Fed-tightening fears.

events.title: Oil Price War + COVID Crash
events.blurb: Saudi-Russia oil war collides with pandemic; circuit breakers tripped.

events.title: Fed Unlimited QE
events.blurb: Fed announces uncapped asset purchases; market bottom.

events.title: Oil Goes Negative
events.blurb: WTI May futures settle at -$37.63 — first ever negative print.

events.title: GameStop Short Squeeze
events.blurb: Retail traders squeeze hedge-fund shorts; meme-stock era.

events.title: Russia Invades Ukraine
events.blurb: Energy & food prices spike; sanctions and SWIFT cutoffs.

events.title: Fed Tightening Begins
events.blurb: Fastest hiking cycle in 40 years to combat 9% inflation.

events.title: UK Mini-Budget Crisis
events.blurb: Truss/Kwarteng tax cuts trigger gilt crash; BoE emergency intervention.

events.title: SVB & Banking Stress
events.blurb: Silicon Valley Bank fails; Credit Suisse rescued by UBS.

events.title: Israel-Hamas War
events.blurb: Middle East tensions reset oil-risk premium.

events.title: Yen Carry Trade Unwind
events.blurb: BoJ hike triggers global vol spike; Nikkei -12% in a day.

events.title: Trump Wins US Election
events.blurb: Republican sweep; tariff and tax-cut agenda priced into markets.

events.title: Liberation Day Tariffs
events.blurb: Sweeping reciprocal US tariffs announced; global market rout.
